title: app-shell: Console write affordance for a user's manager — read-only `manager_id` lookup plus a row action posting objectstack's `set-user-manager` admin endpoint (from objectstack#16678, ruled)
body:
**Filed by the director seat** out of objectstack#16678's Phase 2 ruling (decision batch #127 item 1, maintainer ruling 2026-09-13, verbatim: 「同意 经理 = 管理员在用户上显式设置的 manager_id;部门负责人 = 单元上的 manager_user_id,两者独立。」). ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not dispatched.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#16678
Restart-when: the admin endpoint `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` from objectstack#16678 Phase 3 is merged on objectstack `main` and the `@objectstack/*` version carrying it is adopted in this repo's lockfile.

## What the Console does (shape fixed by the ruling; objectstack#16678 design §6)

1. **`sys_user.manager_id` renders as a read-only lookup** in the existing `group: 'Organization'` of the user record — it can do that today with no objectui change (`readonly: true` on the object, ADR-0092 D4 keeps every non-Tier-1 field non-editable in the standard edit form). ⛔ Not a field in the standard edit form.
2. **The write affordance is a row action** — the same shape `unlock_user` and `set_user_password` already use on `sys_user` — posting the endpoint with `{ userId, managerId }` (`managerId: null` clears). The picker is a user lookup filtered to the same organization.
3. **The action's `visible` predicate carries the directory-sync precedence**: `record.source != "idp_provisioned"`, the shape the three existing self-service identity actions already use — a directory-managed identity does not offer a button whose server side will refuse.
4. **Server refusals surface verbatim**: self-assignment, cycle, depth, cross-organization each come back as a named error; the Console shows the message, ⛔ does not pre-validate a second copy of the rules.
5. ⛔ **What this card must NOT do**: render a picker that writes `manager_id` through the generic data API. The identity write guard refuses it — correctly — and the failure would read as a Console bug.
6. The unit head (`sys_business_unit.manager_user_id`, "Business Unit Head") is a different, already-writable field on the unit and is ⛔ not touched: the ruling keeps the two independent.

## Relations
objectstack#16678 (parent; the endpoint) · objectstack#17931 (approval fallback; independent of this card) · ADR-0092 D1/D4 · `sys-user.object.ts` actions `unlock_user` / `set_user_password` (the row-action precedent).
